summary: This article explains how organized competitive video gaming trains players in strategy, fast reflexes, and teamwork, and how esports tournaments bring the best teams together to compete for a prize.
introduce: Show the title “Esports: Competitive Video Gaming” and give pairs one minute to list everything they already know about this topic. Share a few ideas on the board, then tell students to check which ideas the article confirms.

keyTerms.def: a careful plan for reaching a goal
to try to win against others
to earn the right to take part in something by meeting certain requirements

challengeTerms.def: to work together with others to achieve a shared goal
to change something so that it works as well as possible
exactness and great care in how something is done

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that esports is just as much a real sport as soccer or basketball? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain why both strategy and teamwork are important for an esports team to succeed.
struggling: Pre-teach strategy, compete, and qualify with pictures or gestures, then let weak readers use a K-W-L chart and read the article with a partner.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use collaborate, optimize, and precision in a short paragraph that connects the article to something they learned in another subject.
